# forumulate_service_connector (Resource)

An organization-level service connector (e-signature, meetings, wallet passes, compliance): its `enabled` switch, readable `values` and write-only `secret_values`.

Secret fields (API keys, client secrets, private keys) go in the sensitive `secret_values` map. The API never returns them, only the names of the ones set (`secrets_set`), so drift in a secret cannot be detected; a secret you remove from the map is cleared on the next apply. Fields that need an OAuth hand-off (`zoom`, `google_meet`) are connected in the console after the keys are set: `connected` reports it.

Destroying the resource disconnects the connector and deletes its stored credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "zoom_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "forumulate_service_connector" "zoom" {
  provider_name = "zoom"
  enabled       = true

  values = {
    clientId = "AbCdEf123"
  }

  # Write-only: the API reports which secrets are set, never their values.
  secret_values = {
    clientSecret = var.zoom_client_secret
  }
}

output "zoom_callback_url" {
  value = forumulate_service_connector.zoom.callback_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_name` (String) The connector: one of `apple_wallet`, `docusign`, `drata`, `google_meet`, `google_wallet`, `vanta`, `zoom`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is on. Defaults to on when first saved.
- `secret_values` (Map of String, Sensitive) The connector's secret fields by key. Sensitive and write-only: the API reports only which are set (`secrets_set`).
- `values` (Map of String) The connector's readable fields (client ids, regions, account ids) by key; see `GET /orgs/{orgId}/service-connectors/catalog`. Only the keys you declare are compared on read.

### Read-Only

- `callback_url` (String) The OAuth callback URL to register with the provider, for connectors that use one.
- `configured` (Boolean) Whether every required field is set.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether an OAuth connector has been connected to an account (null for a key-only connector).
- `connected_account` (String) The connected account, when there is one.
- `id` (String) The provider name.
- `last_error` (String) The last error the connector reported.
- `name` (String) The connector's display name.
- `secrets_set` (Set of String) The names of the secret fields that have a stored value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Secrets cannot be imported: set them in secret_values and apply.
terraform import forumulate_service_connector.zoom zoom
```
